lines.zh: 我一张一缩，慢慢浮上去。
lines.en: I pulse and rise slowly.
The current pushes me across the reef.
My bell opens like a flower.

lines.zh: 我漂过冷水的沟，触须垂着。
lines.en: I drift over the cold trench, tendrils hanging.
I sink along the undercurrent.

lines.zh: 我几乎不用力，水替我走。
lines.en: I barely move; the water does it.

lines.zh: 冰封海沟的水很凉，我慢慢漂。
lines.en: The frozen trench is cold; I drift slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块珊瑚，避开它。
lines.en: I drift around a coral head.

lines.zh: 我的光在水里拖出一条线。
lines.en: My glow trails a line through the water.

lines.zh: 一阵水涌来，我翻了半圈。
lines.en: A surge rolls me half over.
I rise and fall through deep water.

lines.zh: 触须扫过沙面，带起细尘。
lines.en: My tendrils brush the sand and raise dust.
I move slowly along the reef wall.

lines.zh: 水越深越静，我漂得更慢。
lines.en: Deeper water is stiller; I drift slower.

lines.zh: 冷了，我就往深层水里沉。
lines.en: When it gets cold I sink into deeper water.

lines.zh: 海水变冷，我的伞收得更紧。
lines.en: As the water cools, my bell draws tighter.

lines.zh: 我借一道上升流飘了很远。
lines.en: An upwelling carries me a long way.

lines.zh: 我的触须扫过一片碎贝壳。
lines.en: My tentacles brush a patch of shell grit.

lines.zh: 我任自己悬着，伞一收一放。
lines.en: I let myself hang, bell folding.

lines.zh: 我的伞轻轻开合，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My bell opens and shuts like breathing.

lines.zh: 一点光从伞边滑到触须尖。
lines.en: A spark runs from my bell to my tendrils.
A jellyfish has nowhere to be.

lines.zh: 我让小鱼从触须间穿过。
lines.en: I let small fish pass between my tendrils.
In cold water my glow shows clearer.
I float above the reef, still.

lines.zh: 深水很暗，我只剩一点亮。
lines.en: The deep is dark; only a little of me glows.

lines.zh: 我让伞口对着暗流来的方向。
lines.en: I turn my bell into the undercurrent.
A whale calls, very far away.

lines.zh: 我的触须一根根垂下去。
lines.en: My tendrils hang down one by one.
The current rocks me gently.

lines.zh: 我等着水把我带到别处。
lines.en: I wait for the water to take me elsewhere.
A flash of light, then dark again.

lines.zh: 你游过来，我翻转了伞面。
lines.en: You swim close; I turn my bell toward you.
I watch you through the gaps in my tendrils.

lines.zh: 你搅起的水把我推开了。
lines.en: Your wake pushes me aside.
I flash once, then hold it back.

lines.zh: 你停在我下面，我慢慢上浮。
lines.en: You halt below me; I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只有一点血。
lines.en: I do not fear you; I have so little to lose.

lines.zh: 你的灯光穿过我的伞，我透亮。
lines.en: Your lamp shines right through my bell.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的呼吸泡慢慢飘过。
lines.en: I drift past your rising breath bubbles.
You reach out; my tendrils retract.
I hover, waiting for you to move.
My bell has a hole ripped in it.
I have almost no flesh to shield me.
All my lights go out at once.
I am scattered out of shape.
A few tendrils break off and drift away.
I shrink into a tiny knot.
That blow nearly ended me.
Water seeps into my bell, cold.
I gather myself back slowly.
I still drift, only crooked.

lines.zh: 你指间那团小东西在扭。
lines.en: That small thing in your fingers wriggles.
I cannot see it well, but I want closer.

lines.zh: 我的触须朝着你伸过去。
lines.en: My tendrils reach out toward you.
Is it food? My glow brightens.
I float slowly up to your hand.
That small motion stops my drifting.
I circle it, afraid to touch.

lines.zh: 你晃那团东西，我的伞跟着转。
lines.en: You wiggle it; my bell turns to follow.
I want to grab it, but I have no hands.

lines.zh: 我贴在它旁边，等它自己进来。
lines.en: I cling beside it and wait.
One bump and my bell dents.

lines.zh: 我被推得翻过来，触须朝天。
lines.en: I am flipped, tendrils pointing up.
I stick to you and cannot slide off.
The squeeze scatters my lights.

lines.zh: 我撞上礁石，软软地摊开。
lines.en: I hit the reef and spread out soft.
Your hand sweeps me aside.
A corner of my bell tears away.
The current spins me around.
It takes me a while to gather myself.
Gently; I bruise at a touch.
Two glows draw near in the water.

lines.zh: 我和她并排漂着，一起亮。
lines.en: She and I drift abreast, glowing together.

lines.zh: 我们的触须缠了一小会儿。
lines.en: Our tendrils tangle for a moment.
Her light is whiter than mine.
We rise together, very slowly.

lines.zh: 水把我们推到同一片暗处。
lines.en: The water brings us to the same dark.
I follow her glow, never rushing.
When we part, our lights still answer.
The young will scatter with the current.

lines.zh: 我们头对头停了一会儿。
lines.en: We pause, bell to bell.

lines.zh: 我用触须卷住一小块肉。
lines.en: I curl a tendril around a scrap of meat.

lines.zh: 它太滑，从我触须间溜走。
lines.en: It is too slippery and slides free.
I tuck it under my bell and carry it.
I cannot hold it, only press against it.

lines.zh: 一小片海草挂在我腕上。
lines.en: A bit of weed snags on my arm.
Dragging it makes my drifting labored.
I guide it into my tendrils.

lines.zh: 两个都想要，我一个也没抓住。
lines.en: I want both and catch neither.
I hide it in a crack of the reef.
I let go and it sinks away.
A small fish circles by the reef.

lines.zh: 那片水在抖，我朝它下沉。
lines.en: The water shivers there; I sink toward it.
It swims slow; I can keep up.

lines.zh: 我把触须铺开，像一张网。
lines.en: I spread my tendrils like a net.

lines.zh: 水里的味道变了，我知道有东西。
lines.en: The water tastes different; something is there.

lines.zh: 我选了个它必经的窄口。
lines.en: I pick a narrow gap it must pass.

lines.zh: 我的光调暗，藏在礁影里。
lines.en: I dim and hide in the reef's shadow.
It is half a body-length away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下沉，堵住它的路。
lines.en: I sink slowly and block its path.
My tendrils already hang over it.

lines.zh: 我跟着它漂，一点都不急。
lines.en: I drift after it, in no hurry.
It dodges, so I change course.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁面把它往角落赶。
lines.en: I herd it toward a corner along the reef.

lines.zh: 我的触须在水里张着等。
lines.en: My tendrils hang open in the water.
It circles the coral, and so do I.
One more inch of drift and we touch.

lines.zh: 我压低了伞，像一片影子。
lines.en: I flatten my bell into a shadow.
It has not noticed the light in the water.
I have closed off the way out.
It brushes against my tendrils.

lines.zh: 我的触须贴上它，它僵住了。
lines.en: My tendril touches it and it goes stiff.
I gently close and wrap it.
It struggles and skews my bell.
The sting passes down my tendril.
I have the strength for only one strike.
I touch it once and pull away.
It goes numb and slowly sinks.
My lights flash wildly in the fight.
That one attempt used all of me.
I hold it and wait for it to stop moving.

lines.zh: 我在寒冷的深沟里成形。
lines.en: I take shape in a cold, deep trench.
Icy water runs off the rim of my bell.
It is dark here; my glow fits.
I drift alone, with no company.

lines.zh: 深水珊瑚在我下面发白。
lines.en: Deep coral pales beneath me.

lines.zh: 温水沟里，我先亮了一下。
lines.en: In the warm trench I flash once.

lines.zh: 水流把我从暗处带出来。
lines.en: The current carries me out of the dark.
I pulse and test the water.

lines.zh: 我的触须慢慢垂到长度。
lines.en: My tendrils lengthen slowly.
I am the only one in this water.
The water warms and my bell curls.

lines.zh: 我被甩到水面，又沉回去。
lines.en: I am flung to the surface and sink back.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，可也难受。
lines.en: I live in water, yet this still hurts.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得翻了几个圈。
lines.en: The shock rolls me over and over.
An arrow pierces the edge of my bell.
A strange force squeezes me tight.

lines.zh: 触须空空的，我越来越淡。
lines.en: My tendrils are empty and I fade.

lines.zh: 电在水里散开，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning spreads through water; I shudder.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，我的伞塌了。
lines.en: No water below; my bell collapses.
